title: TNew Gunpowder Craft
description: This mod add new gunpowder craft to Minecraft.
body: This mod add new **gunpowder craft**, in _realistic_ proportions. New ores can be found in the world in certain biomes. You'll have to travel the world to find the ore you need; you don't need to look for a reason to do so anymore. Of course, night farming remains predominantly better, but I'm not aiming to create a mod for customization, not for single-player enjoyment of the game!
